name: Cucumbermart
source:
Cucumbermart is a visual novel about starting a new grocery store business. You spent your life working for a big grocery store chain, but now you have a chance to open a store of your own. Will you overcome all of the hurdles and lead your business to success?

[from [url=https://avangardum.itch.io/cucumbermart]itch.io[/url]]
